formulae.title: Hutchinson IFS attractor union (Sierpinski-triangle instance)
formulae.basic_explanation: The attractor P is the unique set left invariant by the union of N contraction maps. A chaos-game walk that jumps between three verified half-scale copies of the plane converges onto the Sierpinski triangle.

citation.chicago: Barnsley, Michael F., Robert L. Devaney, Benoit B. Mandelbrot, Heinz-Otto Peitgen, Dietmar Saupe, and Richard F. Voss. 1988. The Science of Fractal Images. New York: Springer.

figures.title: Sierpinski IFS backdrop: structure
figures.description: A structure variation of a Sierpinski-triangle chaos-game density field with rhythmic triangular accents.
figures.figcaption: Sierpinski IFS backdrop. P = w₁(P) ∪ w₂(P) ∪ ⋯ ∪ wₙ(P). The attractor P is the unique set left invariant by the union of N contraction maps. A chaos-game walk that jumps between three verified half-scale copies of the plane converges onto the Sierpinski triangle. (Barnsley et al. 1988, 225).
